selected.title: Visa and Lloyds complete live trials of stablecoin settlement
selected.summary: Visa and Lloyds Banking Group have completed a live pilot exploring how stablecoin-based settlement could support faster, more transparent and flexible cross-border transactions.
selected.why: Live trial of stablecoin settlement by major financial institutions.

reason: Visa-Lloyds stablecoin trial completion raises arguable question: does this demonstrate stablecoins solve real cross-border problems, or validate unnecessary technology looking for problems to solve?
angle: Stablecoin settlement trials prove utility for cross-border payments only if they solve speed or cost problems that existing correspondent banking cannot, which the report does not establish.
